name: The actual plaque builds its frame, illuminates, reveals badge and text, then holds
Top and bottom anchors use mirrored entrance and exit offsets with the same reveal
Opening a menu during illumination freezes every visual value and resumes without replay
Cinematic evolution and HUD hiding freeze both the reveal and the final fade
Game and operating-system reduced motion remove the light wash, blur and movement
The next queued plaque resets all reveal values after the preceding fade
Restart during the light reveal clears presentation state without new listeners or loops
Every plaque has a readable hold, finite bounded motion, and no redundant hold style writes
The offline preview uses production paint, never touches storage, and replays on one loop
